name: bb-plugin-restart-resume
description: bb plugin: continue threads that a bb restart interrupted, by sending each a short continuation message.

bb.name: Restart resume
bb.description: Continue threads interrupted because their machine's bb daemon restarted or lost its connection: each gets a short message to carry on, at most 3 times in a row.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && bb plugin build
